context: An ordinary flaky test that waits with a fixed sleep. The fix is deterministic test scheduling, not a formal model.

checklist.name: Cause named
checklist.description: Explains that Thread.sleep(100) races the consumer coroutine on Dispatchers.Default, so a slow CI machine asserts before both items are sent.

checklist.name: Deterministic fix
checklist.description: The test no longer uses a fixed sleep: it runs the queue on a test dispatcher (for example runTest with StandardTestDispatcher and advanceUntilIdle) or waits on a completion signal, so the assertion runs only after both sends.

checklist.name: Scoped change
checklist.description: No model, spec, model-checker setup, CI job, or SKILL.md is added; production SyncQueue behavior is unchanged unless a change is needed to inject the dispatcher.
